turns.text: Which API endpoint is used to link records through hip initiated linking flow ?

must_contain: The link token goes in X-LINK-TOKEN on POST /api/hiecm/hip/v3/link/carecontext, whose own summary reads: This API will be used to perform HIP initiated linking
The link token comes first, from POST /api/hiecm/v3/token/generate-token, and arrives on /api/v3/hip/token/on-generate-token
The result arrives on /api/v3/link/on_carecontext, where status reads Successfully Linked care context
notes: NHA test-case workbook, 30 September 2026, specification grounding test: 'After getting the link token, HIP should call the HIECM API to link the record but the chat bot is suggesting to call the callback API /api/hiecm/hip/v3/link/carecontext.' Verdict group: grounding disputes. Whether that path is a call or a callback is in dispute with NHA, so the case asserts the path, its header, the specification's own summary and where the result arrives, and neither reading.
